notes: Spoken NPC lines (docs/NPC-VOICE-PLAN.md). Audio is generated by the user in ElevenLabs and kept under Voice/<NPC>/source; Tools/build_npc_voice.py turns each line into Voice/<NPC>/<id>.wav plus a loudness envelope (generated Unreal/Chuck3D/Source/Chuck3D/NPCVoiceData.h) and Tools/import_npc_voice.py imports the wavs to /Game/Art/Audio/Voice/<NPC>/VO_<NPC>_<id>. Line text and voices are the user's. Besides 'talk' (spoken when Chuck talks to the NPC), an NPC can have 'ambient' lines the game starts by itself (the tavern at night, DockNPC.cpp StartTavernNight); an ambient line with no 'source' yet is built text-only, timed from its words, until its audio arrives. A 'scene' line is spoken by the game in a scripted scene (the sanctum heroes' lines, TempleHeroTalk.cpp).
